recoveryKey.title: Save your recovery key

recoveryKey.label: Your recovery key
recoveryKey.confirm: I have written down or printed this key

gone.body: For your safety it isn't kept anywhere you can open again. You can make a new one after you log in.

states.26: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

business.title: Business details
business.lead: Printed on your bills. Old bills keep the details they were printed with.

features.title: Features
features.lead: Switch on what your shop needs. Screens for switched-off features stay hidden.

security.title: Security
security.ownerLockHint: Minutes without use before the owner's login locks.
security.staffIdleHint: Minutes without use before a staff login is logged out.

stock.lead: What billing does when an item runs out.

loggedOut.body: Items belong to a business. Log in to see and change them.

notFound.body: It may have been typed wrong. Open it from the items list.

items.isArchived: This item is archived: it is hidden from billing and can't be changed. Restore it to use it again.

cards.basicsLead: What the item is called on bills and in search.

cards.stockOnlyLead: The codes printed on it, and when to warn that stock is low.

preview.aboveMrp: The selling price is above the MRP. Selling above MRP is against the law.

barcodes.title: Barcodes
barcodes.lead: Scanning any of these at the counter finds this item. Adding or removing one saves at once.
barcodes.newHint: Scan or type the codes printed on it. In-store codes can be made after saving.

levels.title: Low-stock warning
levels.hint: Warn when stock falls to this many {{unit}}. Blank: never.

confirm.archiveBody: It disappears from billing and search. Its history stays, and you can restore it any time.
confirm.restoreBody: It comes back to billing and search.

catalogue.categoriesLead: Group items your way: none are made for you.
catalogue.unitsLead: For packs the built-in units don't cover, like a crate of 24.
catalogue.noUnits: No units of your own yet.
catalogue.defaultSizeHint: An item can change it for itself.

stock.title: Stock
stock.lead: How much is at each branch. Every change saves at once and stays in the history.
stock.noHistory: Nothing has moved at this branch yet.

openingDialog.unitCostHint: Filled in from the purchase price.

adjustDialog.title: Adjust stock: {{name}}
adjustDialog.removeHint: Damaged, expired, lost or taken for use.
adjustDialog.addHint: Only after a count. Goods bought come in as purchases.

stock.elsewhere: Stock is changed at this counter's branch. Switch the branch shown to it to make a change.

login.title: Log in
login.wrongOwner: That email and password don't match. Check both and try again.
login.wrongStaff: That username and password don't match. Check both and try again.
login.tooMany: Too many tries. Try again at {{time}}.
login.noDevice: Staff can log in only on a counter where the owner has logged in. Ask the owner to log in here once.
login.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a few seconds.
login.failed: Couldn't log in. Check the connection and try again.
login.wrongBranch: This login can't work at {{branch}}. Ask the owner to allow it.

chooseBranch.label: This computer is in

lock.title: Counter locked

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.lead: Get a reset link by email, or use the recovery key you saved at signup.

email.lead: We'll email a link to choose a new password. It works only for a confirmed email.
email.sent: If {{email}} has a confirmed account, a link is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.
email.noEmail: No email after a few minutes? Check spam, or use your recovery key.

key.lead: Your recovery key changes the password at once. Each key works once, so you then get a new one.
key.label: Recovery key
key.hint: 32 letters and digits, as you wrote it down. Dashes and spaces don't matter.
key.wrong: That email and recovery key don't match. Check both and try again.
key.done: Your password is changed and you're logged out everywhere. Your old key no longer works: save this new one.

forgot.tooMany: Too many tries. Try again at {{time}}.
forgot.failed: Couldn't send. Check the connection and try again.

resetPage.title: Choose a new password
resetPage.lead: After this you're logged out on every computer, and you log in with the new password.
resetPage.done: Your password is changed. You're logged out on every computer.
resetPage.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. A link works for 30 minutes, once.
resetPage.failed: Couldn't save. Check the connection and try again.

confirmPage.title: Confirm your email
confirmPage.lead: Press the button to confirm this email. Then, if you forget your password, you can reset it by email.
confirmPage.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Log in and press "Send again" on the banner for a new one.
confirmPage.failed: Couldn't confirm. Check the connection and try again.

emailBanner.label: Email confirmation
emailBanner.body: Confirm your email: we sent you a link. Until then, only your recovery key can reset a forgotten password.
emailBanner.limited: In this demo, email reaches only addresses we have verified. If no email comes, keep your recovery key safe: it is your way back in.
emailBanner.sent: Sent. The link works for 7 days.
emailBanner.tooMany: Too many tries. Try again at {{time}}.
emailBanner.failed: Couldn't send. Check the connection and try again.

account.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Not your email or phone number.
account.tooMany: Too many tries. Try again at {{time}}.
account.failed: Couldn't save. Check the connection and try again.

password.title: Password
password.lead: Changing it logs you out on every other computer.
password.done: Password changed. Other computers are logged out.

recoveryKey.title: Recovery key
recoveryKey.lead: Lost your key, or used it? Make a new one. The old key stops working.

devices.title: Computers
devices.lead: Counters that remember this business, so staff can log in there. Forget one you no longer use.
devices.name: Name
devices.forgetThis: This logs you out here, and staff can't log in on this computer until you log in on it again.
devices.forgetOther: Anyone logged in there is logged out, and staff can't log in there until you log in on it again.
devices.moveBody: Bills and stock changes made on this computer will belong to the branch you pick. Anyone logged in on it is logged out.
devices.moveBodyThis: This logs you out here too, and you log in again at the new branch.

person.title: Person
person.name: Name
person.usernameHint: They type this to log in: 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.

access.lead: Choose what this person can do. What you leave off, they can't open.
access.limitHint: From 0 to 100, up to two decimals. Above this, a discount needs your password.
access.noMoney: Staff never see salaries or profit unless you switch it on.
access.confirmBody: Changing what someone can do needs your password.

sell.label: Bill customers
sell.hint: Use the billing screen; hold and resume bills.

discount.label: Give discounts
discount.hint: Up to the limit below. Above it, the bill needs your password.

view.label: Find customers
view.hint: Look customers up at the counter.

view.label: See items
view.hint: Look up items and prices, never the purchase price.

manage.label: Add and edit items
manage.hint: Add, change and archive items, categories and units.

view_cost.label: See purchase prices
view_cost.hint: The price you paid, and the margin.

view.label: See stock
view.hint: How much is in stock, and its history.

adjust.label: Change stock
adjust.hint: Enter opening stock and fix counts.

new.confirmBody: A new login can be used at once, so adding one needs your password.

reset.title: Reset password for {{name}}
reset.body: Choose a new password and tell them. They are logged out on every computer at once, and can change it themselves under My password.
reset.done: New password set for {{name}}. They are logged out everywhere.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.loggedOut: They are logged out at once.
deactivate.undo: You can switch the login back on any time.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.body: They can log in again with the same password and the same access. This needs your password.

notFound.title: No such staff login
notFound.body: It may have been typed wrong. Open it from the staff list.

errors.invalid_permissions: Those switches don't fit together. Reload the page and try again.
errors.not_found: This login no longer exists. Go back to the list.

branches.title: Branches
branches.lead: Each shop of this business, with its own counters, stock and staff. A branch is never deleted: archive it and its history stays.
branches.single: This business has one shop. Add a branch when you open another; nothing else changes until then.

form.name: Branch name
form.codeHint: Up to 6 capital letters or digits. It goes into invoice numbers, like AND.
form.codeInvalid: Use 1 to 6 capital letters or digits
form.codeTaken: Another branch already uses this code
form.gstinHint: A branch in another state needs its own GSTIN.

archive.title: Archive {{name}}?
archive.body: Its computers are forgotten and anyone logged in there is logged out. Its stock and history stay, and you can bring it back later.
archive.inUse_one: {{count}} staff login has this as its home branch. Move them to another branch first.
archive.inUse_other: {{count}} staff logins have this as their home branch. Move them to another branch first.
archive.headOffice: The head office can’t be archived.

access.title: Can also work at
access.lead: The branches, besides the home branch, where this person may log in. They only ever see the branch they are logged in at.
access.confirmBody: This decides which counters this login works on, so it needs your password.
